name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps the interface sleek, matching Manus’ competitive analysis. The trade-off is that some users in bright environments may prefer light mode upfront, but the toggle keeps the default consistent and adaptable.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes bury errors in shadows and mute critical signals—glare is the smaller problem. A high-contrast light theme with a one-click dark toggle keeps visibility sharp by default, while still honoring user preference. Settle it by testing both with real users: measure error rates and task completion time in bright and dim conditions.
